problems.title: Fix Palindrome & Whitespace Bug
problems.description: The given function is supposed to check if a string is a palindrome ignoring case and spaces. Fix the logic and index bounds error.

testCases.input:
A man a plan a canal Panama
No lemon no melon
World

problems.title: Fix Binary Search Off-by-One
problems.description: A classic binary search implementation with boundary index bugs and integer overflow issue. Fix it to pass all test cases.

problems.title: Fix Array Maximum and Memory Bounds
problems.description: Find the maximum element and its count in an integer array. Fix the initialization bug and out-of-bounds loop.
